problem_statement: Let A = {e^{i theta} : |theta| <= pi/2} be the closed quarter-arc with endpoints z = +-i, and let f(e^{i theta}) = 1_A(e^{i theta}) |e^{i theta} - i|^{1/2} |e^{i theta} + i|^{1/2}, i.e. an arc-supported symbol with symmetric root singularities of exponent alpha = 1/4 at each endpoint. Let D_n(f) be its n-by-n Toeplitz determinant. Determine the large-n asymptotic of log D_n(f) through constant order, identifying the Widom capacity term, the endpoint logarithmic correction, and the exact O(1) endpoint constant.
record_title: Widom endpoint constant with power-law error for the quarter-arc Toeplitz determinant with root singularities
